old_woman_01.name: Old Woman
old_woman_01.description: An elderly woman leaning on a wooden cane. She watches everyone who passes through the square with sharp, suspicious eyes.
dialogue: Lovely day, isn't it?
Well... it would be, if people would stop tracking mud through my street.
If you're looking for work, try the commercial district. Someone there is always looking for an extra pair of hands.

peasant_tim.name: Tim the Peasant
peasant_tim.description: A man in ragged clothes and a dull look on his face.
dialogue: Hullo there, mister!
Can you help find my shoes? A rat stole them and scurried down to the sewers.
I know it sounds silly, but those were my best shoes!

skeleton_jim.name: Skeleton Jim
skeleton_jim.description: A skeleton, but it doesn't look hostile...
dialogue: BOOOO!!
Haha! Just kidding, mate. Did I scare ya?
Listen, I dropped my mace in here somewhere. You can keep it if you find it.

guard_aldric.name: Guard Aldric
guard_aldric.description: A tired-looking town guard standing at attention, although his hand rests suspiciously close to a lunch pouch.
dialogue: Keep your weapons sheathed in town.
Oakvale's quiet enough most days. Let's keep it that way.
If you're heading outside the walls, be careful. The roads aren't as safe as they used to be.

guard_mira.name: Guard Mira
guard_mira.description: A young town guard with polished armor and an expression that suggests she has heard every excuse imaginable.
dialogue: Morning.
The south gate is open during the day. Don't wander off after dark unless you know what you're doing.
And no, 'I didn't know' is not a valid excuse for breaking town rules.

blacksmith_garrick.name: Garrick the Blacksmith
blacksmith_garrick.description: A broad-shouldered blacksmith with soot-covered arms and a perpetually singed apron.
dialogue: Need something sharpened?
Iron's reliable. Ugly, heavy, and reliable.
If you find any decent scrap outside town, bring it to me. I'll make something useful out of it.

innkeeper_elsa.name: Elsa the Innkeeper
innkeeper_elsa.description: A cheerful woman standing behind the inn's wooden counter, keeping one eye on the guests and another on the kitchen.
dialogue: Welcome to Oakvale!
A warm bed fixes most problems. The rest usually require a warm meal.
If you're travelling north, stock up before you leave. The road gets lonely.

miller_jonas.name: Jonas the Miller
miller_jonas.description: A middle-aged man covered in flour, with a permanent squint from years of staring at his mill.
dialogue: Morning. Try not to breathe too deeply around here.
Flour gets everywhere. Absolutely everywhere.
The old sewer entrance is farther east than most people realize. Best not to go poking around down there.

apprentice_lina.name: Lina the Apprentice
apprentice_lina.description: A young apprentice carrying an armful of books and looking like she has forgotten where she put half of them.
dialogue: Oh! Sorry. Was I standing in your way?
I'm studying old records about Oakvale.
Apparently there's something underneath the town that is much older than the town itself. Fascinating, right?

priest_benedict.name: Brother Benedict
priest_benedict.description: A calm priest wearing simple robes and carrying a small wooden symbol around his neck.
dialogue: Peace be with you, traveller.
Oakvale may be small, but there is good in its people.
If you venture into dark places, remember that courage is not the absence of fear.

sewer_keeper_hob.name: Hob the Sewer Keeper
sewer_keeper_hob.description: A grumpy old man holding a lantern and a large iron key ring.
dialogue: Don't touch anything down there.
Actually, scratch that. Don't touch MOST things down there.
Rats have gotten bolder lately. Something's been stirring them up.
